title: Up Keep Round 4: White Base, Header, Plan Card, Extras, Tech License, Yard Sign, Van, Uniform On People, Lawn Quote, Moisture-Scan Character
brands: Up Keep / Smart Upkeep: home maintenance membership app (https://webermanapps.github.io/smart-upkeep/)
Base: white or cream, #0A0A0A ink, square black buttons, Khand/Hind; 2-3 small pops (terracotta = act, lagoon = info, jungle = done, saffron = due soon); no neon, no pastel, not all-beige
builds_on: upkeep-3 results (32/50; top tags system, clear, warm, simple, lively; notes: drop score screens, show uniforms on people); upkeep-1 top tags clear, system, warm, lively, multi-accent; upkeep-2 top tags clear, system, visual, guided, easy (no upkeep results files in results/)

pairs.ask: Pure White Or The Current Cream?

optionA.label: Pure White With A Max Weberman Header
optionA.desc: The app screen on pure white. Header like maxweberman.com: logo left, square outlined Share right, thin grey rule.
